read.purpose: The record of the quantities of generation of figure 6 of the paper (question 1 of the verdict of round 5 of the pre-review): for the 20 words of the two trial authors, under map B (version G0 of the blind judgement, the upper half of figure 6) and under the author-equal percentiles (version P, the lower half), the V and A given to the rule and the f, s and gamma of atact.mapping.params, per word, and their minimum, maximum, median and quartiles per version and author. It replaces the ranges of f and s computed by hand by the main agent (decision 4 of .steering/20261029-figure6-outline-v27), which are not used. It also records, from committed records only, why map B narrows the values: the fit of map B (slope, intercept and r of results/calibrate_memolon.json) and the Jacobian of the rule (f depends on A only, s on V only).
